theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate, our only validated edge, shows eligibility and trend health (hurst=trend, not crowded). Despite low breadth suggesting a narrow move, the gate has historically reduced drawdowns in such trends. We lean with the eligible trend, consistent with trend-following discipline.
